caption: The fares array of three values sets the row count, then the table asks for row 1 and that cell draws ₹158. A tap on the row reports index 1, and only that single fare travels onward.

spec.title: How one row reaches the screen
spec.aria: A fares array of 92, 158 and 65 feeds a row count of 3, then the cell setup for row 1, then a cell showing 158 rupees, then the tap on that row recorded as index 1.
